scope: Opt-in --menu-ui integration: original English labels, ANSI Set2 bitmaps and model-derived rectangles, with a host-owned Exit adapter. Not a reconstruction of the complete client UI.
runtime_observation: 2026-10-26: user confirmed corrected --menu-ui works and text appears, but text runs off button borders. Direct host log lists all 13 bindings, glyph and cursor submissions, Exit control activation, 308 submitted frames and normal driver/graphics close. Verified scope is visible static text and bounded host Exit, not accurate layout or original UI behavior. First attempt had rejected text_screen due to reading auxiliary +f0 instead of name +e8; corrected in 54a7c67.
known_issues: Text overflows button borders; investigate original layout, scaling and alignment before claiming visual fidelity.

instruction_anchors.meaning: Frame name setter reads the existing name pointer at frame+e8
Frame name setter copies the requested NUL-terminated name into the buffer at frame+e8
Separate auxiliary-string setter uses frame+f0, not the frame-name field
World-bounds updater takes stack self and sets the world-bound-valid flag at visual+1d0
World-bounds output record starts at visual+170
Viewport getter returns the six-DWORD record and cleans self
BeginScene loads the borrowed original IDirect3DDevice8 pointer from 100d216c; runtime check accounts for relocation
Layout calls the public bounds updater, then copies eight DWORDs from visual+170
Layout bottom is height * minY * -4/3 - 1
Layout top is 1 - height * maxY * 4/3
Negative 4/3 layout constant
Positive 4/3 layout constant
Glyph height uses style height times render height, plus 0.5 before integer truncation
Zero-aspect character advance uses height * 0.4 + 0.5
Font flush selects screen-space vertex format 1
Font flush submits kind 3 triangle lists through IGraph+88
Horizontal alignment 1 takes the unadjusted left position
Horizontal alignment 2 enters the centered branch; 3 is right alignment
Text control forwards its visual at +50 to the bounds layout helper
Exit definition binds localization 2112 with style 13
Exit definition attaches tagged event 06001003 with argument 04000000

binding_policy: Literal definition names have spaces, not Ghidra symbol underscores. Static adapter looks up those exact model nodes, then each button's numbered normal00..normal08 visual beneath its container. The parent/child relationship is checked at runtime, not inferred from screen coordinates.
render_state_policy: New adapter snapshots and restores every D3D render/texture-stage state it changes, stage-zero texture and pixel shader, and restores viewport through IGraph. Device access is a borrowed, fingerprint/relocation-guarded field bridge, not a recovered font API. Do not apply an all-state block: restoring vertex format behind IGraph's FVF cache would desynchronize it.
interaction_policy: Only Exit is enabled; unsupported button captions use the original disabled alpha 0x60. Exit hover uses white focused-text color. Win32 press/release inside the normal07 visual rectangle closes this host; focus loss and dragging outside cancel. This does not reproduce original hover animation, confirmation flow, tagged-event dispatcher or other screens.
asset_policy: Read original loose English TEXTY and ANSI Set2 atlases/metrics locally. Stage a provenance-tracked five-asset slice, including a newly defined H2MT label bundle. No game text or atlas is redistributed. Fixed 800x600; dynamic profile/date/save/version values remain absent.
research_outputs: analysis/work/menu-label-layout (four successful exports; later non-entry request rejected), menu-label-alignment (three), menu-label-final (three), menu-overlay-states (two), menu-overlay-graphics (one format-name query, not a state API). All ignored.
verification_boundary: User desktop observation and direct host log confirm the bounded static-text/Exit milestone only. Exact text fit, blending fidelity, hover/cancellation edge cases and original UI dispatch are not verified by this run. Native tests and ABI anchors alone are not rendering proof.
